messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: gateway error rate spike detected. 1m aggregated 502+ rate = 12% (baseline ~0.6%). Affected prefix: /v1/generate and /v1/chat. See: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/gateway-requests?orgId=1
Alex O'Connor: I'm oncall, looking. Paging eng-sre and runtime. @Maria @Jason can you join?
Maria Chen: on it. grabbing logs from LB and envoy. any customer reports yet?
Sam Torres: Product seeing elevated client errors; a couple customers reported timeouts, support getting surface-level tickets. marking P1 until we know impact.
Jason Patel: looking at proxy metrics now. envoy upstream 502s spiking around 09:03 UTC. upstream connection failures and HTTP/1.1 502 from edge->route.
Priya Shah: checking recent config changes — there was a routing rollout 08:55 from platform that adjusted route weights for model variants to handle burst capacity. rollout id: rollout-20260314-0855.
Alex O'Connor: @deploy-bot can you confirm that rollout was to all regions?
deploy-bot: rollout-20260314-0855: completed to prod-us-west-1 and prod-eu-west-1 at 08:56, staged to prod-us-east-1 at 08:59. No automatic rollback.
Maria Chen: I grabbed an envoy config dump from an edge pod:```json
{"virtual_hosts": [{"name":"api_vhost","routes":[{"match":{"prefix":"/v1/generate"},"route":{"cluster":"inference-cluster","retry_policy":{"retry_on":"5xx,connect-failure","num_retries":3},"timeout":"0s","max_grpc_timeout":"0s"},"per_filter_config":{}}
]}
]}
```
Maria Chen: Notable: `timeout: 0s` and aggressive `num_retries: 3` combined with upstream saturation could be triggering retries that cascade. Also I see route weight change: weights for model-a -> 80, model-b -> 20.
Jason Patel: upstream pods for model-a are showing elevated CPU and gRPC backpressure. A few pods OOM-killed earlier but restarted. `kubectl get pods -l svc=inference-model-a -o wide` shows high restart count.
Leo Nguyen: CS reports 8 customers with visible 5xx in last 10 minutes, two on paid Dedicated plans. prioritizing communication.
Alex O'Connor: Quick mitigation options: 1) revert rollout weights to previous steady state 2) lower retries on route 3) disable retries at LB temporarily 4) scale up model-a pods. Thoughts?
Jason Patel: scaling immediately but might take 2-3m to warm. I can patch HPA target and bump replicas for model-a now: `kubectl scale deployment/model-a --replicas=12`.
Priya Shah: I can prepare a fast rollback for rollout-20260314-0855 to previous weights. rollback command ready. Recommend rollback and temporarily set `num_retries` -> 0 on gateway to stop retry amplification.
Maria Chen: I can push an envoy route patch to set `retry_policy.num_retries: 0` for the api_vhost. Patch plan: `edgectl apply --patch route:api_vhost --set retry_policy.num_retries=0` and watch error rate.
Sam Torres: agree rollback + stop retries seems safest to reduce customer impact quickly. notify SG and CS.
Alex O'Connor: Maria, Priya, Jason take actions. I'll coordinate comms and handoff to next oncall if needed.
Maria Chen: Applying retry patch now (one edge node as canary).```bash
# patch envoy config on node edge-12
curl -X PATCH https://edge-config.redwood.internal/nodes/edge-12/routes/api_vhost -d '{"retry_policy":{"num_retries":0}}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' 
```
Maria Chen: canary node looks stable, 502s on that node dropped to baseline after 30s. rolling to rest of edge nodes.
Jason Patel: scaled model-a replicas up to 12; pods rejoining. CPU per pod back to normal after 90s.
Priya Shah: initiating rollback of rollout-20260314-0855 to previous weights (model-a 50 / model-b 50) via platform console. Command queued.
deploy-bot: rollback rollout-20260314-0855: started -> completed at 09:07 UTC.
Maria Chen: all edges updated with `num_retries: 0`. global 5xx rate dropping from 12% -> 1.1% over 5m.
Leo Nguyen: CS updated customers on initial mitigation and that we're rolling back config; preparing follow-up for impacted customers on Dedicated plans.
Sam Torres: Product to collect list of requests affected and potential user-visible impacts for postmortem.
Alex O'Connor: Good. I'm going to do a quick handoff to night oncall @Maria in 10m. leave notes. who will own postmortem?
Priya Shah: Platform will own postmortem; Priya + Jason + Maria as authors. include timeline, rollout diff, envoy retry policy, and recommended guardrails (e.g., block `num_retries>1` for gateway, require chaos testing for weight changes).
Maria Chen: adding immediate action items to incident doc: 1) add automated check that prevents >2x weight change for a model without staged canary 2) add a metric alert for retry amplification patterns 3) default gateway retry_policy.num_retries=0 for new routes.
Alex O'Connor: handoff: initial responder Alex -> continued by Maria. current status: customer impact reduced, rollback successful, edge retries disabled, model pool scaled. paging cleared if no regressions.
Maria Chen: ack. will stay on for 30m and then update #incidents with final report. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty: Incident acknowledgement recorded by Alex O'Connor at 09:08 UTC. Incident cleared at 09:12 UTC (service degraded -> normal).
Alex O'Connor: thanks everyone. follow-up actions assigned in the incident doc. :eyes:
